sup:70140.text:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very excited about the opportunity to work together with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable partner for your business!

For our offer, we can propose a price of €47.00 per unit, alongside a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We are eager to show you what we can do and hope this initial quote meets your expectations. Let us know if you have any questions at all.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

reply.text:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. We haven't heard back from you regarding our last offer. Please let us know if you have any questions or if we can proceed with the proposed terms. As mentioned before, faster payment is very important to us right now. 

To keep everything clear, our current offer remains a price of €47.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, and a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. This offer stays valid for 30 days. We are very eager to work together and look forward to building a strong relationship with you!

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

Hello,

Hi, we haven't heard back from you on our last email. We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. 

Are we good to go with the €47.00 for 300 ppm? Our current Angebot stands at a price of €47.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, and a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Let us know soon so we can plan our production. We are really keen to work together and look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

Hello,

We are withdrawing from this negotiation. 

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Re: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red [n6527] (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding kalwisz: bearing brackets in red.
Your rolling quality to 2026Q3 stands at 2376 ppm (sc:70140@2026Q3).
Electric power generation producer prices (PPI-D351) changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).
We have reduced the chargeback to EUR 0 per complaint.
We understand your position on list prices, so we have structured the packages below around chargebacks, quality commitment.
We will pay every invoice on its due date, without exception.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 15,900 pcs per year over 12 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Hello,
thank you for your mail, we are very happy to hear from you!
we can move a bit:
Our terms: a price of €47.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint.
To be fully transparent with you:
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything.
We can't give out our cost breakdown, that's internal stuff.
The index drop you found is tiny and doesn't really help us with our costs.
We can do the 800 ppm you want, but we need €46.50 for it, and please make sure you really pay on time like you said!
Material accounts for about 30 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
We are ready when you are!
Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
